2410/// A pure virtual base class for all recipes modeling header phis, including
2411/// phis for first order recurrences, pointer inductions and reductions. The
2412/// start value is the first operand of the recipe and the incoming value from
2413/// the backedge is the second operand.
2414///
2415/// Inductions are modeled using the following sub-classes:
2416/// * VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe: Generates vector values for integer and
2417/// floating point inductions with arbitrary start and step values. Produces
2418/// a vector PHI per-part.
2419/// * VPWidenPointerInductionRecipe: Generate vector and scalar values for a
2420/// pointer induction. Produces either a vector PHI per-part or scalar values
2421/// per-lane based on the canonical induction.
2422/// * VPFirstOrderRecurrencePHIRecipe
2423/// * VPReductionPHIRecipe
2424/// * VPActiveLaneMaskPHIRecipe
2425/// * VPEVLBasedIVPHIRecipe
2426///
2427/// Note that the canonical IV is modeled as a VPRegionValue associated with
2428/// its loop region.
2429class LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPHeaderPHIRecipe : public VPSingleDefRecipe,
2430 public VPPhiAccessors {
2431protected:
2432 VPHeaderPHIRecipe(VPRecipeTy VPRecipeID, Instruction *UnderlyingInstr,
2433 VPValue *Start, DebugLoc DL = DebugLoc::getUnknown())
2434 : VPHeaderPHIRecipe(VPRecipeID, UnderlyingInstr, Start,
2435 Start->getScalarType(), DL) {}
2436
2437 VPHeaderPHIRecipe(VPRecipeTy VPRecipeID, Instruction *UnderlyingInstr,
2438 VPValue *Start, Type *ResultTy, DebugLoc DL)
2439 : VPSingleDefRecipe(VPRecipeID, Start, ResultTy, UnderlyingInstr, DL) {}
2440
2441 const VPRecipeBase *getAsRecipe() const override { return this; }
2442
2443public:
2444 ~VPHeaderPHIRecipe() override = default;
2445
2446 /// Method to support type inquiry through isa, cast, and dyn_cast.
2447 static inline bool classof(const VPRecipeBase *R) {
2448 return R->getVPRecipeID() >= VPRecipeBase::VPFirstHeaderPHISC &&
2449 R->getVPRecipeID() <= VPRecipeBase::VPLastHeaderPHISC;
2450 }
2451 static inline bool classof(const VPValue *V) {
2452 return isa<VPHeaderPHIRecipe>(V->getDefiningRecipe());
2453 }
2454 static inline bool classof(const VPSingleDefRecipe *R) {
2455 return isa<VPHeaderPHIRecipe>(static_cast<const VPRecipeBase *>(R));
2456 }
2457
2458 /// Generate the phi nodes.
2459 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override = 0;
2460
2461 /// Return the cost of this header phi recipe.
2462 InstructionCost computeCost(ElementCount VF,
2463 VPCostContext &Ctx) const override;
2464
2465 /// Returns the start value of the phi, if one is set.
2466 VPValue *getStartValue() {
2467 return getNumOperands() == 0 ? nullptr : getOperand(0);
2468 }
2469 VPValue *getStartValue() const {
2470 return getNumOperands() == 0 ? nullptr : getOperand(0);
2471 }
2472
2473 /// Update the start value of the recipe.
2474 void setStartValue(VPValue *V) { setOperand(0, V); }
2475
2476 /// Returns the incoming value from the loop backedge.
2477 virtual VPValue *getBackedgeValue() {
2478 return getOperand(1);
2479 }
2480
2481 /// Update the incoming value from the loop backedge.
2482 void setBackedgeValue(VPValue *V) { setOperand(1, V); }
2483
2484 /// Add \p V as the incoming value from the loop backedge.
2485 void addBackedgeValue(VPValue *V) {
2486 assert(getNumOperands() == 1 &&
2487 "backedge value must be appended right after construction");
2488 assert(V->getScalarType() == getScalarType() &&
2489 "backedge value must have the same type as the start value");
2490 VPUser::addOperand(V);
2491 }
2492
2493protected:
2494#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
2495 /// Print the recipe.
2496 void printRecipe(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
2497 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override = 0;
2498#endif
2499};

2501/// Base class for widened induction (VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe and

2507public:
2508 VPWidenInductionRecipe(VPRecipeTy Kind, PHINode *IV, VPValue *Start,

2510 DebugLoc DL)
2511 : VPWidenInductionRecipe(Kind, IV, Start, Step, IndDesc,
2512 Start->getScalarType(), DL) {}
2513
2514 VPWidenInductionRecipe(VPRecipeTy Kind, PHINode *IV, VPValue *Start,
2515 VPValue *Step, const InductionDescriptor &IndDesc,
2516 Type *ResultTy, DebugLoc DL)
2517 : VPHeaderPHIRecipe(Kind, IV, Start, ResultTy, DL), IndDesc(IndDesc) {
2518 addOperand(Step);
2519 }
2520
2521 /// After unrolling, append the splat-VF step (`VF * step`) and the value of
2522 /// the induction at the last unrolled part.
2523 void addUnrolledPartOperands(VPValue *SplatVFStep, VPValue *LastPart) {
2524 assert(LastPart->getScalarType() == getScalarType() &&
2525 "last-part value must match the induction recipe's scalar type");
2526 assert((getScalarType()->isPointerTy()
2527 ? SplatVFStep->getScalarType()->isIntegerTy()
2528 : SplatVFStep->getScalarType() == getScalarType()) &&
2529 "splat-step must match the induction type for non-pointer "
2530 "inductions, or be an integer index for pointer inductions");
2531 VPUser::addOperand(SplatVFStep);
2532 VPUser::addOperand(LastPart);
2533 }
2534
2535 static inline bool classof(const VPRecipeBase *R) {
2536 return R->getVPRecipeID() == VPRecipeBase::VPWidenIntOrFpInductionSC ||
2537 R->getVPRecipeID() == VPRecipeBase::VPWidenPointerInductionSC;
2538 }
2539
2540 static inline bool classof(const VPValue *V) {
2541 auto *R = V->getDefiningRecipe();
2542 return R && classof(R);
2543 }
2544
2545 static inline bool classof(const VPSingleDefRecipe *R) {
2546 return classof(static_cast<const VPRecipeBase *>(R));
2547 }
2548
2549 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override = 0;
2550
2551 /// Returns the start value of the induction.
2552 VPIRValue *getStartValue() const { return cast<VPIRValue>(getOperand(0)); }
2553
2554 /// Returns the step value of the induction.
2555 VPValue *getStepValue() { return getOperand(1); }
2556 const VPValue *getStepValue() const { return getOperand(1); }
2557
2558 /// Update the step value of the recipe.
2559 void setStepValue(VPValue *V) { setOperand(1, V); }
2560
2561 VPValue *getVFValue() { return getOperand(2); }
2562 const VPValue *getVFValue() const { return getOperand(2); }
2563
2564 /// Returns the number of incoming values, also number of incoming blocks.
2565 /// Note that at the moment, VPWidenPointerInductionRecipe only has a single
2566 /// incoming value, its start value.
2567 unsigned getNumIncoming() const override { return 1; }
2568
2569 /// Returns the underlying PHINode if one exists, or null otherwise.
2570 PHINode *getPHINode() const {
2571 return cast_if_present<PHINode>(getUnderlyingValue());
2572 }
2573
2574 /// Returns the induction descriptor for the recipe.
2575 const InductionDescriptor &getInductionDescriptor() const { return IndDesc; }
2576
2577 /// Returns the SCEV predicates associated with this induction.
2578 ArrayRef<const SCEVPredicate *> getNoWrapPredicates() const {
2579 return IndDesc.getNoWrapPredicates();
2580 }
2581
2582 VPValue *getBackedgeValue() override {
2583 // TODO: All operands of base recipe must exist and be at same index in
2584 // derived recipe.
2585 llvm_unreachable(
2586 "VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe generates its own backedge value");
2587 }
2588
2589 /// Returns true if the recipe only uses the first lane of operand \p Op.
2590 bool usesFirstLaneOnly(const VPValue *Op) const override {
2591 assert(is_contained(operands(), Op) &&
2592 "Op must be an operand of the recipe");
2593 // The recipe creates its own wide start value, so it only requests the
2594 // first lane of the operand.
2595 // TODO: Remove once creating the start value is modeled separately.
2596 return Op == getStartValue() || Op == getStepValue();
2597 }
2598};

2600/// A recipe for handling phi nodes of integer and floating-point inductions,
2601/// producing their vector values. This is an abstract recipe and must be
2602/// converted to concrete recipes before executing.
2603class VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe : public VPWidenInductionRecipe,
2604 public VPIRFlags {
2605 TruncInst *Trunc;
2606
2607 // If this recipe is unrolled it will have 2 additional operands.
2608 bool isUnrolled() const { return getNumOperands() == 5; }
2609
2610public:
2611 VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe(PHINode *IV, VPIRValue *Start, VPValue *Step,
2612 VPValue *VF, const InductionDescriptor &IndDesc,
2613 const VPIRFlags &Flags, DebugLoc DL)
2614 : VPWidenInductionRecipe(VPRecipeBase::VPWidenIntOrFpInductionSC, IV,
2615 Start, Step, IndDesc, DL),
2616 VPIRFlags(Flags), Trunc(nullptr) {
2617 addOperand(VF);
2618 }
2619
2620 VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe(PHINode *IV, VPIRValue *Start, VPValue *Step,
2621 VPValue *VF, const InductionDescriptor &IndDesc,
2622 TruncInst *Trunc, const VPIRFlags &Flags,
2623 DebugLoc DL)
2624 : VPWidenInductionRecipe(VPRecipeBase::VPWidenIntOrFpInductionSC, IV,
2625 Start, Step, IndDesc,
2626 Trunc ? Trunc->getType() : Start->getType(), DL),
2627 VPIRFlags(Flags), Trunc(Trunc) {
2628 addOperand(VF);
2629 SmallVector<std::pair<unsigned, MDNode *>> Metadata;
2630 if (Trunc)
2631 getMetadataToPropagate(Trunc, Metadata);
2632 assert(Metadata.empty() && "unexpected metadata on Trunc");
2633 }
2634
2635 ~VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe() override = default;
2636
2637 VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe *clone() override {
2638 return new VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe(
2639 getPHINode(), getStartValue(), getStepValue(), getVFValue(),
2640 getInductionDescriptor(), Trunc, *this, getDebugLoc());
2641 }
2642
2643 VP_CLASSOF_IMPL(VPRecipeBase::VPWidenIntOrFpInductionSC)
2644
2645 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override {
2646 llvm_unreachable("cannot execute this recipe, should be expanded via "
2647 "expandVPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipe");
2648 }
2649
2650 /// If the recipe has been unrolled, return the VPValue for the induction
2651 /// increment, otherwise return null.
2652 VPValue *getSplatVFValue() const {
2653 return isUnrolled() ? getOperand(getNumOperands() - 2) : nullptr;
2654 }
2655
2656 /// Returns the number of incoming values, also number of incoming blocks.
2657 /// Note that at the moment, VPWidenIntOrFpInductionRecipes only have a single
2658 /// incoming value, its start value.
2659 unsigned getNumIncoming() const override { return 1; }
2660
2661 /// Returns the first defined value as TruncInst, if it is one or nullptr
2662 /// otherwise.
2663 TruncInst *getTruncInst() { return Trunc; }
2664 const TruncInst *getTruncInst() const { return Trunc; }
2665
2666 /// Returns true if the induction is canonical, i.e. starting at 0 and
2667 /// incremented by UF * VF (= the original IV is incremented by 1) and has the
2668 /// same type as the canonical induction.
2669 bool isCanonical() const;
2670
2671 /// Returns the VPValue representing the value of this induction at
2672 /// the last unrolled part, if it exists. Returns itself if unrolling did not
2673 /// take place.
2674 VPValue *getLastUnrolledPartOperand() {
2675 return isUnrolled() ? getOperand(getNumOperands() - 1) : this;
2676 }
2677
2678protected:
2679#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
2680 /// Print the recipe.
2681 void printRecipe(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
2682 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override;
2683#endif
2684};

2816/// Possible variants of a reduction.
2817
2818/// This reduction is ordered and in-loop.
2819struct RdxOrdered {};
2820/// This reduction is in-loop.
2821struct RdxInLoop {};
2822/// This reduction is unordered with the partial result scaled down by some
2823/// factor.
2824struct RdxUnordered {
2825 unsigned VFScaleFactor;
2826};
2827using ReductionStyle = std::variant<RdxOrdered, RdxInLoop, RdxUnordered>;
2828
2829inline ReductionStyle getReductionStyle(bool InLoop, bool Ordered,
2830 unsigned ScaleFactor) {
2831 assert((!Ordered || InLoop) && "Ordered implies in-loop");
2832 if (Ordered)
2833 return RdxOrdered{};
2834 if (InLoop)
2835 return RdxInLoop{};
2836 return RdxUnordered{/*VFScaleFactor=*/ScaleFactor};
2837}
2838
2839/// A recipe for handling reduction phis. The start value is the first operand
2840/// of the recipe and the incoming value from the backedge is the second
2841/// operand.
2842class VPReductionPHIRecipe : public VPHeaderPHIRecipe, public VPIRFlags {
2843 /// The recurrence kind of the reduction.
2844 const RecurKind Kind;
2845
2846 ReductionStyle Style;
2847
2848 /// The phi is part of a multi-use reduction (e.g., used in FindIV
2849 /// patterns for argmin/argmax).
2850 /// TODO: Also support cases where the phi itself has a single use, but its
2851 /// compare has multiple uses.
2852 bool HasUsesOutsideReductionChain;
2853
2854public:
2855 /// Create a new VPReductionPHIRecipe for the reduction \p Phi.
2856 VPReductionPHIRecipe(PHINode *Phi, RecurKind Kind, VPValue &Start,
2857 VPValue &BackedgeValue, ReductionStyle Style,
2858 const VPIRFlags &Flags,
2859 bool HasUsesOutsideReductionChain = false)
2860 : VPHeaderPHIRecipe(VPRecipeBase::VPReductionPHISC, Phi, &Start),
2861 VPIRFlags(Flags), Kind(Kind), Style(Style),
2862 HasUsesOutsideReductionChain(HasUsesOutsideReductionChain) {
2863 addOperand(&BackedgeValue);
2864 }
2865
2866 ~VPReductionPHIRecipe() override = default;
2867
2868 VPReductionPHIRecipe *cloneWithOperands(VPValue *Start,
2869 VPValue *BackedgeValue) {
2870 return new VPReductionPHIRecipe(
2871 dyn_cast_or_null<PHINode>(getUnderlyingValue()), getRecurrenceKind(),
2872 *Start, *BackedgeValue, Style, *this, HasUsesOutsideReductionChain);
2873 }
2874
2875 VPReductionPHIRecipe *clone() override {
2876 return cloneWithOperands(getOperand(0), getBackedgeValue());
2877 }
2878
2879 VP_CLASSOF_IMPL(VPRecipeBase::VPReductionPHISC)
2880
2881 /// Generate the phi/select nodes.
2882 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override;
2883
2884 /// Get the factor that the VF of this recipe's output should be scaled by, or
2885 /// 1 if it isn't scaled.
2886 unsigned getVFScaleFactor() const {
2887 auto *Partial = std::get_if<RdxUnordered>(&Style);
2888 return Partial ? Partial->VFScaleFactor : 1;
2889 }
2890
2891 /// Set the VFScaleFactor for this reduction phi. Can only be set to a factor
2892 /// > 1.
2893 void setVFScaleFactor(unsigned ScaleFactor) {
2894 assert(ScaleFactor > 1 && "must set to scale factor > 1");
2895 Style = RdxUnordered{ScaleFactor};
2896 }
2897
2898 /// Returns the recurrence kind of the reduction.
2899 RecurKind getRecurrenceKind() const { return Kind; }
2900
2901 /// Returns true, if the phi is part of an ordered reduction.
2902 bool isOrdered() const { return std::holds_alternative<RdxOrdered>(Style); }
2903
2904 /// Returns true if the phi is part of an in-loop reduction.
2905 bool isInLoop() const {
2906 return std::holds_alternative<RdxInLoop>(Style) ||
2907 std::holds_alternative<RdxOrdered>(Style);
2908 }
2909
2910 /// Returns true if the reduction outputs a vector with a scaled down VF.
2911 bool isPartialReduction() const { return getVFScaleFactor() > 1; }
2912
2913 /// Returns true, if the phi is part of a multi-use reduction.
2914 bool hasUsesOutsideReductionChain() const {
2915 return HasUsesOutsideReductionChain;
2916 }
2917
2918 /// Returns true if the recipe only uses the first lane of operand \p Op.
2919 bool usesFirstLaneOnly(const VPValue *Op) const override {
2920 assert(is_contained(operands(), Op) &&
2921 "Op must be an operand of the recipe");
2922 return isOrdered() || isInLoop();
2923 }
2924
2925protected:
2926#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
2927 /// Print the recipe.
2928 void printRecipe(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
2929 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override;
2930#endif
2931};

2933/// A recipe for vectorizing a phi-node as a sequence of mask-based select
2934/// instructions.
2935class LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPBlendRecipe : public VPRecipeWithIRFlags {
2936public:
2937 /// The blend operation is a User of the incoming values and of their
2938 /// respective masks, ordered [I0, M0, I1, M1, I2, M2, ...]. Note that M0 can
2939 /// be omitted (implied by passing an odd number of operands) in which case
2940 /// all other incoming values are merged into it.
2941 VPBlendRecipe(PHINode *Phi, ArrayRef<VPValue *> Operands,
2942 const VPIRFlags &Flags, DebugLoc DL)
2943 : VPRecipeWithIRFlags(VPRecipeBase::VPBlendSC, Operands,
2944 Operands[0]->getScalarType(), Flags, DL) {
2945 assert(Operands.size() >= 2 && "Expected at least two operands!");
2946 assert(all_of(seq<unsigned>(0, getNumIncomingValues()),
2947 [this](unsigned I) {
2948 return getIncomingValue(I)->getScalarType() ==
2949 getScalarType();
2950 }) &&
2951 "all incoming values must have the same type");
2952 assert(all_of(seq<unsigned>(isNormalized(), getNumIncomingValues()),
2953 [this](unsigned I) {
2954 return getMask(I)->getScalarType()->isIntegerTy(1);
2955 }) &&
2956 "masks must be a bool");
2957 setUnderlyingValue(Phi);
2958 }
2959
2960 VPBlendRecipe *clone() override { return cloneWithOperands(operands()); }
2961
2962 VPBlendRecipe *cloneWithOperands(ArrayRef<VPValue *> NewOperands) {
2963 return new VPBlendRecipe(cast_or_null<PHINode>(getUnderlyingValue()),
2964 NewOperands, *this, getDebugLoc());
2965 }
2966
2967 VP_CLASSOF_IMPL(VPRecipeBase::VPBlendSC)
2968
2969 /// A normalized blend is one that has an odd number of operands, whereby the
2970 /// first operand does not have an associated mask.
2971 bool isNormalized() const { return getNumOperands() % 2; }
2972
2973 /// Return the number of incoming values, taking into account when normalized
2974 /// the first incoming value will have no mask.
2975 unsigned getNumIncomingValues() const {
2976 return (getNumOperands() + isNormalized()) / 2;
2977 }
2978
2979 /// Return incoming value number \p Idx.
2980 VPValue *getIncomingValue(unsigned Idx) const {
2981 return Idx == 0 ? getOperand(0) : getOperand(Idx * 2 - isNormalized());
2982 }
2983
2984 /// Return mask number \p Idx.
2985 VPValue *getMask(unsigned Idx) const {
2986 assert((Idx > 0 || !isNormalized()) && "First index has no mask!");
2987 return Idx == 0 ? getOperand(1) : getOperand(Idx * 2 + !isNormalized());
2988 }
2989
2990 /// Set mask number \p Idx to \p V.
2991 void setMask(unsigned Idx, VPValue *V) {
2992 assert((Idx > 0 || !isNormalized()) && "First index has no mask!");
2993 assert(V->getScalarType()->isIntegerTy(1) && "Mask must be an i1 (vector)");
2994 Idx == 0 ? setOperand(1, V) : setOperand(Idx * 2 + !isNormalized(), V);
2995 }
2996
2997 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override {
2998 llvm_unreachable("VPBlendRecipe should be expanded by simplifyBlends");
2999 }
3000
3001 /// Return the cost of this VPWidenMemoryRecipe.
3002 InstructionCost computeCost(ElementCount VF,
3003 VPCostContext &Ctx) const override;
3004
3005 /// Returns true if the recipe only uses the first lane of operand \p Op.
3006 bool usesFirstLaneOnly(const VPValue *Op) const override;
3007
3008protected:
3009#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
3010 /// Print the recipe.
3011 void printRecipe(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
3012 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override;
3013#endif
3014};
3015
3016/// A common base class for interleaved memory operations.
3017/// An Interleaved memory operation is a memory access method that combines
3018/// multiple strided loads/stores into a single wide load/store with shuffles.
3019/// The first operand is the start address. The optional operands are, in order,
3020/// the stored values and the mask.
3021class LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPInterleaveBase : public VPRecipeBase,
3022 public VPIRMetadata {
3023 const InterleaveGroup<Instruction> *IG;
3024
3025 /// Indicates if the interleave group is in a conditional block and requires a
3026 /// mask.
3027 bool HasMask = false;
3028
3029 /// Indicates if gaps between members of the group need to be masked out or if
3030 /// unusued gaps can be loaded speculatively.
3031 bool NeedsMaskForGaps = false;
3032
3033protected:
3034 VPInterleaveBase(VPRecipeTy SC, const InterleaveGroup<Instruction> *IG,
3035 ArrayRef<VPValue *> Operands,
3036 ArrayRef<VPValue *> StoredValues, VPValue *Mask,
3037 bool NeedsMaskForGaps, const VPIRMetadata &MD, DebugLoc DL)
3038 : VPRecipeBase(SC, Operands, DL), VPIRMetadata(MD), IG(IG),
3039 NeedsMaskForGaps(NeedsMaskForGaps) {
3040 // TODO: extend the masked interleaved-group support to reversed access.
3041 assert((!Mask || !IG->isReverse()) &&
3042 "Reversed masked interleave-group not supported.");
3043 if (StoredValues.empty()) {
3044 for (Instruction *Inst : IG->members()) {
3045 assert(!Inst->getType()->isVoidTy() && "must have result");
3046 new VPMultiDefValue(this, Inst, Inst->getType());
3047 }
3048 } else {
3049 for (auto *SV : StoredValues)
3050 addOperand(SV);
3051 }
3052 if (Mask) {
3053 HasMask = true;
3054 addOperand(Mask);
3055 }
3056 }
3057
3058public:
3059 VPInterleaveBase *clone() override = 0;
3060
3061 static inline bool classof(const VPRecipeBase *R) {
3062 return R->getVPRecipeID() == VPRecipeBase::VPInterleaveSC ||
3063 R->getVPRecipeID() == VPRecipeBase::VPInterleaveEVLSC;
3064 }
3065
3066 static inline bool classof(const VPUser *U) {
3067 auto *R = dyn_cast<VPRecipeBase>(U);
3068 return R && classof(R);
3069 }
3070
3071 /// Return the address accessed by this recipe.
3072 VPValue *getAddr() const {
3073 return getOperand(0); // Address is the 1st, mandatory operand.
3074 }
3075
3076 /// Return the mask used by this recipe. Note that a full mask is represented
3077 /// by a nullptr.
3078 VPValue *getMask() const {
3079 // Mask is optional and the last operand.
3080 return HasMask ? getOperand(getNumOperands() - 1) : nullptr;
3081 }
3082
3083 /// Return true if the access needs a mask because of the gaps.
3084 bool needsMaskForGaps() const { return NeedsMaskForGaps; }
3085
3086 const InterleaveGroup<Instruction> *getInterleaveGroup() const { return IG; }
3087
3088 Instruction *getInsertPos() const { return IG->getInsertPos(); }
3089
3090 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override {
3091 llvm_unreachable("VPInterleaveBase should not be instantiated.");
3092 }
3093
3094 /// Return the cost of this recipe.
3095 InstructionCost computeCost(ElementCount VF,
3096 VPCostContext &Ctx) const override;
3097
3098 /// Returns true if the recipe only uses the first lane of operand \p Op.
3099 bool usesFirstLaneOnly(const VPValue *Op) const override = 0;
3100
3101 /// Returns the number of stored operands of this interleave group. Returns 0
3102 /// for load interleave groups.
3103 virtual unsigned getNumStoreOperands() const = 0;
3104
3105 /// Return the VPValues stored by this interleave group. If it is a load
3106 /// interleave group, return an empty ArrayRef.
3107 ArrayRef<VPValue *> getStoredValues() const {
3108 return {op_end() - (getNumStoreOperands() + (HasMask ? 1 : 0)),
3109 getNumStoreOperands()};
3110 }
3111};

3113/// VPInterleaveRecipe is a recipe for transforming an interleave group of load
3114/// or stores into one wide load/store and shuffles. The first operand of a
3115/// VPInterleave recipe is the address, followed by the stored values, followed
3116/// by an optional mask.
3117class LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPInterleaveRecipe final : public VPInterleaveBase {
3118public:
3119 VPInterleaveRecipe(const InterleaveGroup<Instruction> *IG, VPValue *Addr,
3120 ArrayRef<VPValue *> StoredValues, VPValue *Mask,
3121 bool NeedsMaskForGaps, const VPIRMetadata &MD, DebugLoc DL)
3122 : VPInterleaveBase(VPRecipeBase::VPInterleaveSC, IG, Addr, StoredValues,
3123 Mask, NeedsMaskForGaps, MD, DL) {}
3124
3125 ~VPInterleaveRecipe() override = default;
3126
3127 VPInterleaveRecipe *clone() override {
3128 return new VPInterleaveRecipe(getInterleaveGroup(), getAddr(),
3129 getStoredValues(), getMask(),
3130 needsMaskForGaps(), *this, getDebugLoc());
3131 }
3132
3133 VP_CLASSOF_IMPL(VPRecipeBase::VPInterleaveSC)
3134
3135 /// Generate the wide load or store, and shuffles.
3136 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override;
3137
3138 bool usesFirstLaneOnly(const VPValue *Op) const override {
3139 assert(is_contained(operands(), Op) &&
3140 "Op must be an operand of the recipe");
3141 return Op == getAddr() && !llvm::is_contained(getStoredValues(), Op);
3142 }
3143
3144 unsigned getNumStoreOperands() const override {
3145 return getNumOperands() - (getMask() ? 2 : 1);
3146 }
3147
3148protected:
3149#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
3150 /// Print the recipe.
3151 void printRecipe(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
3152 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override;
3153#endif

3156/// A recipe for interleaved memory operations with vector-predication
3157/// intrinsics. The first operand is the address, the second operand is the
3158/// explicit vector length. Stored values and mask are optional operands.
3159class LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPInterleaveEVLRecipe final : public VPInterleaveBase {
3160public:
3161 VPInterleaveEVLRecipe(VPInterleaveRecipe &R, VPValue &EVL, VPValue *Mask)
3162 : VPInterleaveBase(VPRecipeBase::VPInterleaveEVLSC,
3163 R.getInterleaveGroup(), {R.getAddr(), &EVL},
3164 R.getStoredValues(), Mask, R.needsMaskForGaps(), R,
3165 R.getDebugLoc()) {
3166 assert(!getInterleaveGroup()->isReverse() &&
3167 "Reversed interleave-group with tail folding is not supported.");
3168 assert(!needsMaskForGaps() && "Interleaved access with gap mask is not "
3169 "supported for scalable vector.");
3170 }
3171
3172 ~VPInterleaveEVLRecipe() override = default;
3173
3174 VPInterleaveEVLRecipe *clone() override {
3175 llvm_unreachable("cloning not implemented yet");
3176 }
3177
3178 VP_CLASSOF_IMPL(VPRecipeBase::VPInterleaveEVLSC)
3179
3180 /// The VPValue of the explicit vector length.
3181 VPValue *getEVL() const { return getOperand(1); }
3182
3183 /// Generate the wide load or store, and shuffles.
3184 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override;
3185
3186 /// The recipe only uses the first lane of the address, and EVL operand.
3187 bool usesFirstLaneOnly(const VPValue *Op) const override {
3188 assert(is_contained(operands(), Op) &&
3189 "Op must be an operand of the recipe");
3190 return (Op == getAddr() && !llvm::is_contained(getStoredValues(), Op)) ||
3191 Op == getEVL();
3192 }
3193
3194 unsigned getNumStoreOperands() const override {
3195 return getNumOperands() - (getMask() ? 3 : 2);
3196 }
3197
3198protected:
3199#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
3200 /// Print the recipe.
3201 void printRecipe(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
3202 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override;
3203#endif
3204};

3206/// A recipe to represent inloop, ordered or partial reduction operations. It
3207/// performs a reduction on a vector operand into a scalar (vector in the case
3208/// of a partial reduction) value, and adds the result to a chain. The Operands
3209/// are {ChainOp, VecOp, [Condition]}.
3210class LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPReductionRecipe : public VPRecipeWithIRFlags {
3211
3212 /// The recurrence kind for the reduction in question.
3213 RecurKind RdxKind;
3214 /// Whether the reduction is conditional.
3215 bool IsConditional = false;
3216 ReductionStyle Style;
3217
3218protected:
3219 VPReductionRecipe(VPRecipeTy SC, RecurKind RdxKind, FastMathFlags FMFs,
3220 Instruction *I, ArrayRef<VPValue *> Operands,
3221 VPValue *CondOp, ReductionStyle Style, DebugLoc DL)
3222 : VPRecipeWithIRFlags(SC, Operands, Operands[0]->getScalarType(), FMFs,
3223 DL),
3224 RdxKind(RdxKind), Style(Style) {
3225 assert(all_of(Operands,
3226 [this](VPValue *VPV) {
3227 return VPV->getScalarType() == getScalarType() ||
3228 (isa<VPInstruction>(VPV) &&
3229 cast<VPInstruction>(VPV)->getOpcode() ==
3230 VPInstruction::ExplicitVectorLength);
3231 }) &&
3232 "all incoming values must have the same type");
3233 if (CondOp) {
3234 assert(CondOp->getScalarType()->isIntegerTy(1) &&
3235 "CondOp must be a bool");
3236 IsConditional = true;
3237 addOperand(CondOp);
3238 }
3239 setUnderlyingValue(I);
3240 }
3241
3242public:
3243 VPReductionRecipe(RecurKind RdxKind, FastMathFlags FMFs, Instruction *I,
3244 VPValue *ChainOp, VPValue *VecOp, VPValue *CondOp,
3245 ReductionStyle Style, DebugLoc DL = DebugLoc::getUnknown())
3246 : VPReductionRecipe(VPRecipeBase::VPReductionSC, RdxKind, FMFs, I,
3247 {ChainOp, VecOp}, CondOp, Style, DL) {}
3248
3249 VPReductionRecipe(const RecurKind RdxKind, FastMathFlags FMFs,
3250 VPValue *ChainOp, VPValue *VecOp, VPValue *CondOp,
3251 ReductionStyle Style, DebugLoc DL = DebugLoc::getUnknown())
3252 : VPReductionRecipe(VPRecipeBase::VPReductionSC, RdxKind, FMFs, nullptr,
3253 {ChainOp, VecOp}, CondOp, Style, DL) {}
3254
3255 ~VPReductionRecipe() override = default;
3256
3257 VPReductionRecipe *clone() override {
3258 return new VPReductionRecipe(RdxKind, getFastMathFlagsOrNone(),
3259 getUnderlyingInstr(), getChainOp(), getVecOp(),
3260 getCondOp(), Style, getDebugLoc());
3261 }
3262
3263 static inline bool classof(const VPRecipeBase *R) {
3264 return R->getVPRecipeID() == VPRecipeBase::VPReductionSC ||
3265 R->getVPRecipeID() == VPRecipeBase::VPReductionEVLSC;
3266 }
3267
3268 static inline bool classof(const VPUser *U) {
3269 auto *R = dyn_cast<VPRecipeBase>(U);
3270 return R && classof(R);
3271 }
3272
3273 static inline bool classof(const VPValue *VPV) {
3274 const VPRecipeBase *R = VPV->getDefiningRecipe();
3275 return R && classof(R);
3276 }
3277
3278 static inline bool classof(const VPSingleDefRecipe *R) {
3279 return classof(static_cast<const VPRecipeBase *>(R));
3280 }
3281
3282 /// Generate the reduction in the loop.
3283 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override;
3284
3285 /// Return the cost of VPReductionRecipe.
3286 InstructionCost computeCost(ElementCount VF,
3287 VPCostContext &Ctx) const override;
3288
3289 /// Return the recurrence kind for the in-loop reduction.
3290 RecurKind getRecurrenceKind() const { return RdxKind; }
3291 /// Return true if the in-loop reduction is ordered.
3292 bool isOrdered() const { return std::holds_alternative<RdxOrdered>(Style); };
3293 /// Return true if the in-loop reduction is conditional.
3294 bool isConditional() const { return IsConditional; };
3295 /// Returns true if the reduction outputs a vector with a scaled down VF.
3296 bool isPartialReduction() const { return getVFScaleFactor() > 1; }
3297 /// Returns true if the reduction is in-loop.
3298 bool isInLoop() const {
3299 return std::holds_alternative<RdxInLoop>(Style) ||
3300 std::holds_alternative<RdxOrdered>(Style);
3301 }
3302 /// The VPValue of the scalar Chain being accumulated.
3303 VPValue *getChainOp() const { return getOperand(0); }
3304 /// The VPValue of the vector value to be reduced.
3305 VPValue *getVecOp() const { return getOperand(1); }
3306 /// The VPValue of the condition for the block.
3307 VPValue *getCondOp() const {
3308 return isConditional() ? getOperand(getNumOperands() - 1) : nullptr;
3309 }
3310 /// Get the factor that the VF of this recipe's output should be scaled by, or
3311 /// 1 if it isn't scaled.
3312 unsigned getVFScaleFactor() const {
3313 auto *Partial = std::get_if<RdxUnordered>(&Style);
3314 return Partial ? Partial->VFScaleFactor : 1;
3315 }
3316
3317protected:
3318#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
3319 /// Print the recipe.
3320 void printRecipe(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
3321 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override;
3322#endif
3323};

3325/// A recipe to represent inloop reduction operations with vector-predication

3327/// vector length (EVL) into a scalar value, and adding the result to a chain.
3328/// The Operands are {ChainOp, VecOp, EVL, [Condition]}.
3329class LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPReductionEVLRecipe : public VPReductionRecipe {

3332 DebugLoc DL = DebugLoc::getUnknown())
3333 : VPReductionRecipe(VPRecipeBase::VPReductionEVLSC, R.getRecurrenceKind(),
3334 R.getFastMathFlagsOrNone(),
3335 cast_or_null<Instruction>(R.getUnderlyingValue()),
3336 {R.getChainOp(), R.getVecOp(), &EVL}, CondOp,
3337 getReductionStyle(/*InLoop=*/true, R.isOrdered(), 1),
3338 DL) {}
3339
3340 ~VPReductionEVLRecipe() override = default;
3341
3342 VPReductionEVLRecipe *clone() override {
3343 llvm_unreachable("cloning not implemented yet");
3344 }
3345
3346 VP_CLASSOF_IMPL(VPRecipeBase::VPReductionEVLSC)
3347
3348 /// Generate the reduction in the loop
3349 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override;
3350
3351 /// The VPValue of the explicit vector length.
3352 VPValue *getEVL() const { return getOperand(2); }
3353
3354 /// Returns true if the recipe only uses the first lane of operand \p Op.
3355 bool usesFirstLaneOnly(const VPValue *Op) const override {

3359 }
3360
3361protected:
3362#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)

3369/// VPReplicateRecipe replicates a given instruction producing multiple scalar
3370/// copies of the original scalar type, one per lane, instead of producing a
3371/// single copy of widened type for all lanes. If the instruction is known to be
3372/// a single scalar, only one copy will be generated.
3373class LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPReplicateRecipe : public VPRecipeWithIRFlags,
3374 public VPIRMetadata {
3375 /// Indicator if only a single replica per lane is needed.
3376 bool IsSingleScalar;
3377
3378 /// Indicator if the replicas are also predicated.
3379 bool IsPredicated;
3380
3381public:
3382 VPReplicateRecipe(Instruction *I, ArrayRef<VPValue *> Operands,
3383 bool IsSingleScalar, VPValue *Mask = nullptr,
3384 const VPIRFlags &Flags = {}, VPIRMetadata Metadata = {},
3385 DebugLoc DL = DebugLoc::getUnknown())
3386 : VPRecipeWithIRFlags(VPRecipeBase::VPReplicateSC, Operands,
3387 computeScalarType(I, Operands), Flags, DL),
3388 VPIRMetadata(Metadata), IsSingleScalar(IsSingleScalar),
3389 IsPredicated(Mask) {
3390 assert((!IsSingleScalar || !I->isCast()) &&
3391 "single-scalar casts should use VPInstructionWithType");
3392 setUnderlyingValue(I);
3393 if (Mask)
3394 addOperand(Mask);
3395 }
3396
3397 ~VPReplicateRecipe() override = default;
3398
3399 /// Compute the scalar result type for a VPReplicateRecipe wrapping \p I with
3400 /// \p Operands (excluding any predicate mask).
3401 static Type *computeScalarType(const Instruction *I,
3402 ArrayRef<VPValue *> Operands);
3403
3404 VPReplicateRecipe *clone() override { return cloneWithOperands(operands()); }
3405
3406 VPReplicateRecipe *cloneWithOperands(ArrayRef<VPValue *> NewOperands) {
3407 auto *Copy = new VPReplicateRecipe(
3408 getUnderlyingInstr(), NewOperands, IsSingleScalar,
3409 isPredicated() ? getMask() : nullptr, *this, *this, getDebugLoc());
3410 Copy->transferFlags(*this);
3411 return Copy;
3412 }
3413
3414 VP_CLASSOF_IMPL(VPRecipeBase::VPReplicateSC)
3415
3416 /// Generate replicas of the desired Ingredient. Replicas will be generated
3417 /// for all parts and lanes unless a specific part and lane are specified in
3418 /// the \p State.
3419 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override;
3420
3421 /// Return the cost of this VPReplicateRecipe.
3422 InstructionCost computeCost(ElementCount VF,
3423 VPCostContext &Ctx) const override;
3424
3425 /// Return the cost of scalarizing a call to \p CalledFn with argument
3426 /// operands \p ArgOps for a given \p VF.
3427 static InstructionCost computeCallCost(Function *CalledFn, Type *ResultTy,
3428 ArrayRef<const VPValue *> ArgOps,
3429 bool IsSingleScalar, ElementCount VF,
3430 VPCostContext &Ctx);
3431
3432 bool isSingleScalar() const { return IsSingleScalar; }
3433
3434 bool isPredicated() const { return IsPredicated; }
3435
3436 /// Returns true if the recipe only uses the first lane of operand \p Op.
3437 bool usesFirstLaneOnly(const VPValue *Op) const override {
3438 assert(is_contained(operands(), Op) &&
3439 "Op must be an operand of the recipe");
3440 return isSingleScalar();
3441 }
3442
3443 /// Returns true if the recipe uses scalars of operand \p Op.
3444 bool usesScalars(const VPValue *Op) const override {
3445 assert(is_contained(operands(), Op) &&
3446 "Op must be an operand of the recipe");
3447 return true;
3448 }
3449
3450 /// Return the mask of a predicated VPReplicateRecipe.
3451 VPValue *getMask() {
3452 assert(isPredicated() && "Trying to get the mask of a unpredicated recipe");
3453 return getOperand(getNumOperands() - 1);
3454 }
3455
3456 /// Return the recipe's operands, excluding the mask of a predicated recipe.
3457 operand_range operandsWithoutMask() {
3458 return isPredicated() ? drop_end(operands()) : operands();
3459 }
3460
3461 /// Returns the number of operands, excluding the mask if the recipe is
3462 /// predicated.
3463 unsigned getNumOperandsWithoutMask() const {
3464 return getNumOperands() - isPredicated();
3465 }
3466
3467 unsigned getOpcode() const { return getUnderlyingInstr()->getOpcode(); }
3468
3469protected:
3470#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
3471 /// Print the recipe.
3472 void printRecipe(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
3473 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override;
3474#endif
3475};

3514/// A recipe to combine multiple recipes into a single 'expression' recipe,
3515/// which should be considered a single entity for cost-modeling and transforms.
3516/// The recipe needs to be 'decomposed', i.e. replaced by its individual
3517/// expression recipes, before execute. The individual expression recipes are
3518/// completely disconnected from the def-use graph of other recipes not part of
3519/// the expression. Def-use edges between pairs of expression recipes remain
3520/// intact, whereas every edge between an expression recipe and a recipe outside
3521/// the expression is elevated to connect the non-expression recipe with the
3522/// VPExpressionRecipe itself.
3523class VPExpressionRecipe : public VPSingleDefRecipe {
3524 /// Recipes included in this VPExpressionRecipe. This could contain
3525 /// duplicates.
3526 SmallVector<VPSingleDefRecipe *> ExpressionRecipes;
3527
3528 /// Temporary VPValues used for external operands of the expression, i.e.
3529 /// operands not defined by recipes in the expression.
3530 SmallVector<VPValue *> LiveInPlaceholders;
3531
3532 enum class ExpressionTypes {
3533 /// Represents an inloop extended reduction operation, performing a
3534 /// reduction on an extended vector operand into a scalar value, and adding
3535 /// the result to a chain.
3536 ExtendedReduction,
3537 /// Represents an inloop extended reduction operation, which is negated,
3538 /// then reduced before adding the result to a chain.
3539 NegatedExtendedReduction,
3540 /// Represent an inloop multiply-accumulate reduction, multiplying the
3541 /// extended vector operands, performing a reduction.add on the result, and
3542 /// adding the scalar result to a chain.
3543 ExtMulAccReduction,
3544 /// Represent an inloop multiply-accumulate reduction, multiplying the
3545 /// vector operands, performing a reduction.add on the result, and adding
3546 /// the scalar result to a chain.
3547 MulAccReduction,
3548 /// Represent an inloop multiply-accumulate reduction, multiplying the
3549 /// extended vector operands, negating the multiplication, performing a
3550 /// reduction.add on the result, and adding the scalar result to a chain.
3551 ExtNegatedMulAccReduction,
3552 };
3553
3554 /// Type of the expression.
3555 ExpressionTypes ExpressionType;
3556
3557 /// Construct a new VPExpressionRecipe by internalizing recipes in \p
3558 /// ExpressionRecipes. External operands (i.e. not defined by another recipe
3559 /// in the expression) are replaced by temporary VPValues and the original
3560 /// operands are transferred to the VPExpressionRecipe itself. Clone recipes
3561 /// as needed (excluding last) to ensure they are only used by other recipes
3562 /// in the expression.
3563 VPExpressionRecipe(ExpressionTypes ExpressionType,
3564 ArrayRef<VPSingleDefRecipe *> ExpressionRecipes);
3565
3566public:
3567 VPExpressionRecipe(VPWidenCastRecipe *Ext, VPReductionRecipe *Red)
3568 : VPExpressionRecipe(ExpressionTypes::ExtendedReduction, {Ext, Red}) {}
3569 VPExpressionRecipe(VPWidenCastRecipe *Ext, VPWidenRecipe *Neg,
3570 VPReductionRecipe *Red)
3571 : VPExpressionRecipe(ExpressionTypes::NegatedExtendedReduction,
3572 {Ext, Neg, Red}) {
3573 assert((Red->getRecurrenceKind() == RecurKind::Add ||
3574 Red->getRecurrenceKind() == RecurKind::FAdd ||
3575 Red->getRecurrenceKind() == RecurKind::AddChainWithSubs) &&
3576 "Expected an add or add-chain-with-subs reduction");
3577 if (Neg->getOpcode() == Instruction::Sub) {
3578 [[maybe_unused]] auto *SubConst = dyn_cast<VPConstantInt>(getOperand(1));
3579 assert(SubConst && SubConst->isZero() && "Expected a negating sub");
3580 } else
3581 assert(Neg->getOpcode() == Instruction::FNeg && "Unexpected opcode");
3582 }
3583 VPExpressionRecipe(VPWidenRecipe *Mul, VPReductionRecipe *Red)
3584 : VPExpressionRecipe(ExpressionTypes::MulAccReduction, {Mul, Red}) {}
3585 VPExpressionRecipe(VPWidenCastRecipe *Ext0, VPWidenCastRecipe *Ext1,
3586 VPWidenRecipe *Mul, VPReductionRecipe *Red)
3587 : VPExpressionRecipe(ExpressionTypes::ExtMulAccReduction,
3588 {Ext0, Ext1, Mul, Red}) {}
3589 VPExpressionRecipe(VPWidenCastRecipe *Ext0, VPWidenCastRecipe *Ext1,
3590 VPWidenRecipe *Mul, VPWidenRecipe *Neg,
3591 VPReductionRecipe *Red)
3592 : VPExpressionRecipe(ExpressionTypes::ExtNegatedMulAccReduction,
3593 {Ext0, Ext1, Mul, Neg, Red}) {
3594 assert((Mul->getOpcode() == Instruction::Mul ||
3595 Mul->getOpcode() == Instruction::FMul) &&
3596 "Expected a mul");
3597 assert((Red->getRecurrenceKind() == RecurKind::Add ||
3598 Red->getRecurrenceKind() == RecurKind::FAdd ||
3599 Red->getRecurrenceKind() == RecurKind::AddChainWithSubs) &&
3600 "Expected an add or add-chain-with-subs reduction");
3601 assert(getNumOperands() >= 3 && "Expected at least three operands");
3602 if (Neg->getOpcode() == Instruction::Sub) {
3603 [[maybe_unused]] auto *SubConst = dyn_cast<VPConstantInt>(getOperand(2));
3604 assert(SubConst && SubConst->isZero() &&
3605 Neg->getOpcode() == Instruction::Sub && "Expected a negating sub");
3606 } else
3607 assert(Neg->getOpcode() == Instruction::FNeg && "Unexpected opcode");
3608 }
3609
3610 ~VPExpressionRecipe() override {
3611 SmallPtrSet<VPSingleDefRecipe *, 4> ExpressionRecipesSeen;
3612 for (auto *R : reverse(ExpressionRecipes)) {
3613 if (ExpressionRecipesSeen.insert(R).second)
3614 delete R;
3615 }
3616 for (VPValue *T : LiveInPlaceholders)
3617 delete T;
3618 }
3619
3620 VP_CLASSOF_IMPL(VPRecipeBase::VPExpressionSC)
3621
3622 VPExpressionRecipe *clone() override {
3623 assert(!ExpressionRecipes.empty() && "empty expressions should be removed");
3624 SmallVector<VPSingleDefRecipe *> NewExpressiondRecipes;
3625 for (auto *R : ExpressionRecipes)
3626 NewExpressiondRecipes.push_back(R->clone());
3627 for (auto *New : NewExpressiondRecipes) {
3628 for (const auto &[Idx, Old] : enumerate(ExpressionRecipes))
3629 New->replaceUsesOfWith(Old, NewExpressiondRecipes[Idx]);
3630 // Update placeholder operands in the cloned recipe to use the external
3631 // operands, to be internalized when the cloned expression is constructed.
3632 for (const auto &[Placeholder, OutsideOp] :
3633 zip(LiveInPlaceholders, operands()))
3634 New->replaceUsesOfWith(Placeholder, OutsideOp);
3635 }
3636 return new VPExpressionRecipe(ExpressionType, NewExpressiondRecipes);
3637 }
3638
3639 /// Insert the recipes of the expression back into the VPlan, directly before
3640 /// the current recipe. Leaves the expression recipe empty, which must be
3641 /// removed before codegen.
3642 void decompose();
3643
3644 unsigned getVFScaleFactor() const {
3645 auto *PR = dyn_cast<VPReductionRecipe>(ExpressionRecipes.back());
3646 return PR ? PR->getVFScaleFactor() : 1;
3647 }
3648
3649 /// Method for generating code, must not be called as this recipe is abstract.
3650 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override {
3651 llvm_unreachable("recipe must be removed before execute");
3652 }
3653
3654 InstructionCost computeCost(ElementCount VF,
3655 VPCostContext &Ctx) const override;
3656
3657 /// Returns true if this expression contains recipes that may read from or
3658 /// write to memory.
3659 bool mayReadOrWriteMemory() const;
3660
3661 /// Returns true if this expression contains recipes that may have side
3662 /// effects.
3663 bool mayHaveSideEffects() const;
3664
3665 /// Returns true if this VPExpressionRecipe produces a single scalar.
3666 bool isVectorToScalar() const;
3667
3668protected:
3669#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
3670 /// Print the recipe.
3671 void printRecipe(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
3672 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override;
3673#endif
3674};

3676/// VPPredInstPHIRecipe is a recipe for generating the phi nodes needed when

3687 PredV->getScalarType(), /*UV=*/nullptr, DL) {}

3700 /// Return the cost of this VPPredInstPHIRecipe.

3715/// A common mixin class for widening memory operations. An optional mask can be
3716/// provided as the last operand.
3717class LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPWidenMemoryRecipe : public VPIRMetadata {
3718protected:
3719 Instruction &Ingredient;
3720
3721 /// Alignment information for this memory access.
3722 Align Alignment;
3723
3724 /// Whether the accessed addresses are consecutive.
3725 bool Consecutive;
3726
3727 /// Whether the memory access is masked.
3728 bool IsMasked = false;
3729
3730 void setMask(VPValue *Mask) {
3731 assert(!IsMasked && "cannot re-set mask");
3732 if (!Mask)
3733 return;
3734 assert(Mask->getScalarType()->isIntegerTy(1) &&
3735 "Mask must be an i1 (vector)");
3736 getAsRecipe()->addOperand(Mask);
3737 IsMasked = true;
3738 }
3739
3740 VPWidenMemoryRecipe(Instruction &I, bool Consecutive,
3741 const VPIRMetadata &Metadata)
3742 : VPIRMetadata(Metadata), Ingredient(I),
3743 Alignment(getLoadStoreAlignment(&I)), Consecutive(Consecutive) {}
3744
3745public:
3746 virtual ~VPWidenMemoryRecipe() = default;
3747
3748 /// Return a VPRecipeBase* to the current object.
3749 virtual VPRecipeBase *getAsRecipe() = 0;
3750 virtual const VPRecipeBase *getAsRecipe() const = 0;
3751
3752 /// Return whether the loaded-from / stored-to addresses are consecutive.
3753 bool isConsecutive() const { return Consecutive; }
3754
3755 /// Return the address accessed by this recipe.
3756 VPValue *getAddr() const { return getAsRecipe()->getOperand(0); }
3757
3758 /// Returns true if the recipe is masked.
3759 bool isMasked() const { return IsMasked; }
3760
3761 /// Return the mask used by this recipe. Note that a full mask is represented
3762 /// by a nullptr.
3763 VPValue *getMask() const {
3764 // Mask is optional and therefore the last operand.
3765 const VPRecipeBase *R = getAsRecipe();
3766 return isMasked() ? R->getOperand(R->getNumOperands() - 1) : nullptr;
3767 }
3768
3769 /// Returns the alignment of the memory access.
3770 Align getAlign() const { return Alignment; }
3771
3772 /// Return the cost of this VPWidenMemoryRecipe.
3773 InstructionCost computeCost(ElementCount VF, VPCostContext &Ctx) const;
3774
3775 Instruction &getIngredient() const { return Ingredient; }
3776};

3882 VPValue *Mask, bool Consecutive,
3883 const VPIRMetadata &Metadata, DebugLoc DL)

3891 getStoredValue(), getMask(), Consecutive,

3893 }

3896
3897 /// Return the value stored by this recipe.

3903 /// Return the cost of this VPWidenStoreRecipe.

3929/// A recipe for widening store operations with vector-predication intrinsics,
3930/// using the value to store, the address to store to, the explicit vector
3931/// length and an optional mask.
3932struct LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPWidenStoreEVLRecipe final
3933 : public VPRecipeBase,
3934 public VPWidenMemoryRecipe {
3935 VPWidenStoreEVLRecipe(VPWidenStoreRecipe &S, VPValue *Addr,
3936 VPValue *StoredVal, VPValue &EVL, VPValue *Mask)
3937 : VPRecipeBase(VPRecipeBase::VPWidenStoreEVLSC, {Addr, StoredVal, &EVL},
3938 S.getDebugLoc()),
3939 VPWidenMemoryRecipe(S.getIngredient(), S.isConsecutive(), S) {
3940 setMask(Mask);
3941 }
3942
3943 VPWidenStoreEVLRecipe *clone() override {
3944 llvm_unreachable("cloning not supported");
3945 }
3946
3947 VP_CLASSOF_IMPL(VPRecipeBase::VPWidenStoreEVLSC)
3948
3949 /// Return the address accessed by this recipe.
3950 VPValue *getStoredValue() const { return getOperand(1); }
3951
3952 /// Return the EVL operand.
3953 VPValue *getEVL() const { return getOperand(2); }
3954
3955 /// Generate the wide store or scatter.
3956 LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST void execute(VPTransformState &State) override;
3957
3958 /// Return the cost of this VPWidenStoreEVLRecipe.
3959 LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST InstructionCost
3960 computeCost(ElementCount VF, VPCostContext &Ctx) const override;
3961
3962 /// Returns true if the recipe only uses the first lane of operand \p Op.
3963 bool usesFirstLaneOnly(const VPValue *Op) const override {
3964 assert(is_contained(operands(), Op) &&
3965 "Op must be an operand of the recipe");
3966 if (Op == getEVL()) {
3967 assert(getStoredValue() != Op && "unexpected store of EVL");
3968 return true;
3969 }
3970 // Widened, consecutive memory operations only demand the first lane of
3971 // their address, unless the same operand is also stored. That latter can
3972 // happen with opaque pointers.
3973 return Op == getAddr() && isConsecutive() && Op != getStoredValue();
3974 }
3975
3976protected:
3977 LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPRecipeBase *getAsRecipe() override;
3978 LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST const VPRecipeBase *getAsRecipe() const override;
3979
3980#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
3981 /// Print the recipe.
3982 LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST void printRecipe(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
3983 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override;
3984#endif
3985};

4110 new VPWidenCanonicalIVRecipe(getCanonicalIV(), getNoWrapFlags());
4111 if (VPValue *Step = getStepValue())
4112 WideCanIV->addPerPartStep(Step);
4113 return WideCanIV;

4209/// A recipe for handling phi nodes of integer and floating-point inductions,
4210/// producing their scalar values. Before unrolling by UF the recipe represents
4211/// the VF*UF scalar values to be produced, or UF scalar values if only first
4212/// lane is used, and has 3 operands: IV, step and VF. Unrolling adds one extra
4213/// operand StartIndex to all unroll parts except part 0, as the recipe
4214/// represents the VF scalar values (this number of values is taken from
4215/// State.VF rather than from the VF operand) starting at IV + StartIndex.
4216class LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPScalarIVStepsRecipe : public VPRecipeWithIRFlags {
4217 Instruction::BinaryOps InductionOpcode;
4218
4219public:
4220 VPScalarIVStepsRecipe(VPValue *IV, VPValue *Step, VPValue *VF,
4221 Instruction::BinaryOps Opcode, FastMathFlags FMFs = {},
4222 DebugLoc DL = DebugLoc::getUnknown())
4223 : VPRecipeWithIRFlags(VPRecipeBase::VPScalarIVStepsSC, {IV, Step, VF},
4224 IV->getScalarType(), FMFs, DL),
4225 InductionOpcode(Opcode) {}
4226
4227 ~VPScalarIVStepsRecipe() override = default;
4228
4229 VPScalarIVStepsRecipe *clone() override {
4230 auto *NewR = new VPScalarIVStepsRecipe(
4231 getOperand(0), getOperand(1), getOperand(2), InductionOpcode,
4232 getFastMathFlagsOrNone(), getDebugLoc());
4233 if (VPValue *StartIndex = getStartIndex())
4234 NewR->setStartIndex(StartIndex);
4235 return NewR;
4236 }
4237
4238 VP_CLASSOF_IMPL(VPRecipeBase::VPScalarIVStepsSC)
4239
4240 /// Generate the scalarized versions of the phi node as needed by their users.
4241 void execute(VPTransformState &State) override;
4242
4243 /// Return the cost of this VPScalarIVStepsRecipe.
4244 InstructionCost computeCost(ElementCount VF,
4245 VPCostContext &Ctx) const override;
4246
4247 VPValue *getStepValue() const { return getOperand(1); }
4248
4249 /// Return the number of scalars to produce per unroll part, used to compute
4250 /// StartIndex during unrolling.
4251 VPValue *getVFValue() const { return getOperand(2); }
4252
4253 /// Return the StartIndex, or null if known to be zero, valid only after
4254 /// unrolling.
4255 VPValue *getStartIndex() const {
4256 return getNumOperands() == 4 ? getOperand(3) : nullptr;
4257 }
4258
4259 /// Set or add the StartIndex operand.
4260 void setStartIndex(VPValue *StartIndex) {
4261 if (getNumOperands() == 4)
4262 setOperand(3, StartIndex);
4263 else
4264 addOperand(StartIndex);
4265 }
4266
4267 /// Returns true if the recipe only uses the first lane of operand \p Op.
4268 bool usesFirstLaneOnly(const VPValue *Op) const override {
4269 assert(is_contained(operands(), Op) &&
4270 "Op must be an operand of the recipe");
4271 return true;
4272 }
4273
4274 Instruction::BinaryOps getInductionOpcode() const { return InductionOpcode; }
4275
4276protected:
4277#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
4278 /// Print the recipe.
4279 void printRecipe(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
4280 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override;
4281#endif
4282};

4284/// CastInfo helper for casting from VPRecipeBase to a mixin class that is not
4285/// part of the VPRecipeBase class hierarchy (e.g. VPPhiAccessors,
4286/// VPIRMetadata).
4287namespace vpdetail {
4288template <typename VPMixin, typename... RecipeTys>
4289struct CastInfoMixinImpl
4290 : public DefaultDoCastIfPossible<VPMixin *, VPRecipeBase *,
4291 CastInfoMixinImpl<VPMixin, RecipeTys...>> {
4292 static_assert((std::is_base_of_v<VPMixin, RecipeTys> && ...),
4293 "Each type in RecipeTys must derive from VPMixin");
4294
4295 /// Used by isa.
4296 static bool isPossible(VPRecipeBase *R) { return isa<RecipeTys...>(R); }
4297
4298 /// Used by cast.
4299 static VPMixin *doCast(VPRecipeBase *R) {
4300 VPMixin *Out = nullptr;
4301 ((Out = dyn_cast<RecipeTys>(R)) || ...);
4302 assert(Out && "Illegal recipe for cast");
4303 return Out;
4304 }
4305 static VPMixin *castFailed() { return nullptr; }
4306};
4307} // namespace vpdetail

4355/// VPBasicBlock serves as the leaf of the Hierarchical Control-Flow Graph. It
4356/// holds a sequence of zero or more VPRecipe's each representing a sequence of
4357/// output IR instructions. All PHI-like recipes must come before any non-PHI recipes.
4358class LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPBasicBlock : public VPBlockBase {
4359 friend class VPlan;
4360
4361 /// Use VPlan::createVPBasicBlock to create VPBasicBlocks.
4362 VPBasicBlock(const Twine &Name = "", VPRecipeBase *Recipe = nullptr)
4363 : VPBlockBase(VPBasicBlockSC, Name.str()) {
4364 if (Recipe)
4365 appendRecipe(Recipe);
4366 }
4367
4368public:
4369 using RecipeListTy = iplist<VPRecipeBase>;
4370
4371protected:
4372 /// The VPRecipes held in the order of output instructions to generate.
4373 RecipeListTy Recipes;
4374
4375 VPBasicBlock(VPBlockTy BlockSC, const Twine &Name = "")
4376 : VPBlockBase(BlockSC, Name.str()) {}
4377
4378public:
4379 ~VPBasicBlock() override {
4380 while (!Recipes.empty())
4381 Recipes.pop_back();
4382 }
4383
4384 /// Instruction iterators...
4385 using iterator = RecipeListTy::iterator;
4386 using const_iterator = RecipeListTy::const_iterator;
4387 using reverse_iterator = RecipeListTy::reverse_iterator;
4388 using const_reverse_iterator = RecipeListTy::const_reverse_iterator;
4389
4390 //===--------------------------------------------------------------------===//
4391 /// Recipe iterator methods
4392 ///
4393 inline iterator begin() { return Recipes.begin(); }
4394 inline const_iterator begin() const { return Recipes.begin(); }
4395 inline iterator end() { return Recipes.end(); }
4396 inline const_iterator end() const { return Recipes.end(); }
4397
4398 inline reverse_iterator rbegin() { return Recipes.rbegin(); }
4399 inline const_reverse_iterator rbegin() const { return Recipes.rbegin(); }
4400 inline reverse_iterator rend() { return Recipes.rend(); }
4401 inline const_reverse_iterator rend() const { return Recipes.rend(); }
4402
4403 inline size_t size() const { return Recipes.size(); }
4404 inline bool empty() const { return Recipes.empty(); }
4405 inline const VPRecipeBase &front() const { return Recipes.front(); }
4406 inline VPRecipeBase &front() { return Recipes.front(); }
4407 inline const VPRecipeBase &back() const { return Recipes.back(); }
4408 inline VPRecipeBase &back() { return Recipes.back(); }
4409
4410 /// Returns a reference to the list of recipes.
4411 RecipeListTy &getRecipeList() { return Recipes; }
4412
4413 /// Returns a pointer to a member of the recipe list.
4414 static RecipeListTy VPBasicBlock::*getSublistAccess(VPRecipeBase *) {
4415 return &VPBasicBlock::Recipes;
4416 }
4417
4418 /// Method to support type inquiry through isa, cast, and dyn_cast.
4419 static inline bool classof(const VPBlockBase *V) {
4420 return V->getVPBlockID() == VPBlockBase::VPBasicBlockSC ||
4421 V->getVPBlockID() == VPBlockBase::VPIRBasicBlockSC;
4422 }
4423
4424 void insert(VPRecipeBase *Recipe, iterator InsertPt) {
4425 assert(Recipe && "No recipe to append.");
4426 assert(!Recipe->Parent && "Recipe already in VPlan");
4427 Recipe->Parent = this;
4428 Recipes.insert(InsertPt, Recipe);
4429 }
4430
4431 /// Augment the existing recipes of a VPBasicBlock with an additional
4432 /// \p Recipe as the last recipe.
4433 void appendRecipe(VPRecipeBase *Recipe) { insert(Recipe, end()); }
4434
4435 /// The method which generates the output IR instructions that correspond to
4436 /// this VPBasicBlock, thereby "executing" the VPlan.
4437 void execute(VPTransformState *State) override;
4438
4439 /// Return the cost of this VPBasicBlock.
4440 InstructionCost cost(ElementCount VF, VPCostContext &Ctx) override;
4441
4442 /// Return the position of the first non-phi node recipe in the block.
4443 iterator getFirstNonPhi();
4444
4445 /// Returns an iterator range over the PHI-like recipes in the block.
4446 iterator_range<iterator> phis() {
4447 return make_range(begin(), getFirstNonPhi());
4448 }
4449
4450 /// Split current block at \p SplitAt by inserting a new block between the
4451 /// current block and its successors and moving all recipes starting at
4452 /// SplitAt to the new block. Returns the new block.
4453 VPBasicBlock *splitAt(iterator SplitAt);
4454
4455 VPRegionBlock *getEnclosingLoopRegion();
4456 const VPRegionBlock *getEnclosingLoopRegion() const;
4457
4458#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
4459 /// Print this VPBsicBlock to \p O, prefixing all lines with \p Indent. \p
4460 /// SlotTracker is used to print unnamed VPValue's using consequtive numbers.
4461 ///
4462 /// Note that the numbering is applied to the whole VPlan, so printing
4463 /// individual blocks is consistent with the whole VPlan printing.
4464 void print(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
4465 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override;
4466 using VPBlockBase::print; // Get the print(raw_stream &O) version.
4467#endif
4468
4469 /// If the block has multiple successors, return the branch recipe terminating
4470 /// the block. If there are no or only a single successor, return nullptr;
4471 VPRecipeBase *getTerminator();
4472 const VPRecipeBase *getTerminator() const;
4473
4474 /// Returns true if the block is exiting it's parent region.
4475 bool isExiting() const;
4476
4477 /// Clone the current block and it's recipes, without updating the operands of
4478 /// the cloned recipes.
4479 VPBasicBlock *clone() override;
4480
4481 /// Returns the predecessor block at index \p Idx with the predecessors as per
4482 /// the corresponding plain CFG. If the block is an entry block to a region,
4483 /// the first predecessor is the single predecessor of a region, and the
4484 /// second predecessor is the exiting block of the region.
4485 const VPBasicBlock *getCFGPredecessor(unsigned Idx) const;
4486
4487protected:
4488 /// Execute the recipes in the IR basic block \p BB.
4489 void executeRecipes(VPTransformState *State, BasicBlock *BB);
4490
4491 /// Connect the VPBBs predecessors' in the VPlan CFG to the IR basic block
4492 /// generated for this VPBB.
4493 void connectToPredecessors(VPTransformState &State);
4494
4495private:
4496 /// Create an IR BasicBlock to hold the output instructions generated by this
4497 /// VPBasicBlock, and return it. Update the CFGState accordingly.
4498 BasicBlock *createEmptyBasicBlock(VPTransformState &State);
4499};

4501inline const VPBasicBlock *
4502VPPhiAccessors::getIncomingBlock(unsigned Idx) const {
4503 return getAsRecipe()->getParent()->getCFGPredecessor(Idx);
4504}

4506/// A special type of VPBasicBlock that wraps an existing IR basic block.
4507/// Recipes of the block get added before the first non-phi instruction in the
4508/// wrapped block.
4509/// Note: At the moment, VPIRBasicBlock can only be used to wrap VPlan's
4510/// preheader block.
4511class VPIRBasicBlock : public VPBasicBlock {
4512 friend class VPlan;
4513
4514 BasicBlock *IRBB;
4515
4516 /// Use VPlan::createVPIRBasicBlock to create VPIRBasicBlocks.
4517 VPIRBasicBlock(BasicBlock *IRBB)
4518 : VPBasicBlock(VPIRBasicBlockSC,
4519 (Twine("ir-bb<") + IRBB->getName() + Twine(">")).str()),
4520 IRBB(IRBB) {}
4521
4522public:
4523 ~VPIRBasicBlock() override = default;
4524
4525 static inline bool classof(const VPBlockBase *V) {
4526 return V->getVPBlockID() == VPBlockBase::VPIRBasicBlockSC;
4527 }
4528
4529 /// The method which generates the output IR instructions that correspond to
4530 /// this VPBasicBlock, thereby "executing" the VPlan.
4531 void execute(VPTransformState *State) override;
4532
4533 VPIRBasicBlock *clone() override;
4534
4535 BasicBlock *getIRBasicBlock() const { return IRBB; }
4536};

4538/// Track information about the canonical IV and header mask of a loop region.
4539/// TODO: Have it also track the canonical IV increment, subject of NUW flag.
4540class VPCanonicalIVInfo {
4541 /// VPRegionValue for the canonical IV, whose allocation is managed by
4542 /// VPCanonicalIVInfo.
4543 std::unique_ptr<VPRegionValue> CanIV;
4544
4545 /// Optional VPRegionValue for the header mask, set when tail folding.
4546 std::unique_ptr<VPRegionValue> HeaderMask;
4547
4548 /// Whether the increment of the canonical IV may unsigned wrap or not.
4549 bool HasNUW = true;
4550
4551public:
4552 VPCanonicalIVInfo(Type *Ty, DebugLoc DL, VPRegionBlock *Region)
4553 : CanIV(std::make_unique<VPRegionValue>(Ty, DL, Region)) {}
4554
4555 VPRegionValue *getRegionValue() { return CanIV.get(); }
4556 const VPRegionValue *getRegionValue() const { return CanIV.get(); }
4557
4558 VPRegionValue *getHeaderMask() const { return HeaderMask.get(); }
4559
4560 /// Create the header mask for the region and return it. Must only be called
4561 /// when no header mask exists yet.
4562 VPRegionValue *createHeaderMask() {
4563 assert(!HeaderMask && "Header mask already created");
4564 HeaderMask = std::make_unique<VPRegionValue>(
4565 Type::getInt1Ty(CanIV->getType()->getContext()), DebugLoc::getUnknown(),
4566 CanIV->getDefiningRegion());
4567 return HeaderMask.get();
4568 }
4569
4570 bool hasNUW() const { return HasNUW; }
4571
4572 void clearNUW() { HasNUW = false; }
4573};
4574
4575/// VPRegionBlock represents a collection of VPBasicBlocks and VPRegionBlocks
4576/// which form a Single-Entry-Single-Exiting subgraph of the output IR CFG.
4577/// A VPRegionBlock may indicate that its contents are to be replicated several
4578/// times. This is designed to support predicated scalarization, in which a
4579/// scalar if-then code structure needs to be generated VF * UF times. Having
4580/// this replication indicator helps to keep a single model for multiple
4581/// candidate VF's. The actual replication takes place only once the desired VF
4582/// and UF have been determined.
4583class LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPRegionBlock : public VPBlockBase {
4584 friend class VPlan;
4585
4586 /// Hold the Single Entry of the SESE region modelled by the VPRegionBlock.
4587 VPBlockBase *Entry;
4588
4589 /// Hold the Single Exiting block of the SESE region modelled by the
4590 /// VPRegionBlock.
4591 VPBlockBase *Exiting;
4592
4593 /// Holds the Canonical IV of the loop region along with additional
4594 /// information. If CanIVInfo is nullptr, the region is a replicating region.
4595 /// Loop regions retain their canonical IVs until they are dissolved, even if
4596 /// the canonical IV has no users.
4597 std::unique_ptr<VPCanonicalIVInfo> CanIVInfo;
4598
4599 /// Use VPlan::createLoopRegion() and VPlan::createReplicateRegion() to create
4600 /// VPRegionBlocks.
4601 VPRegionBlock(VPBlockBase *Entry, VPBlockBase *Exiting,
4602 const std::string &Name = "")
4603 : VPBlockBase(VPRegionBlockSC, Name), Entry(Entry), Exiting(Exiting) {
4604 if (Entry) {
4605 assert(!Entry->hasPredecessors() && "Entry block has predecessors.");
4606 assert(Exiting && "Must also pass Exiting if Entry is passed.");
4607 assert(!Exiting->hasSuccessors() && "Exit block has successors.");
4608 Entry->setParent(this);
4609 Exiting->setParent(this);
4610 }
4611 }
4612
4613 VPRegionBlock(Type *CanIVTy, DebugLoc DL, VPBlockBase *Entry,
4614 VPBlockBase *Exiting, const std::string &Name = "")
4615 : VPRegionBlock(Entry, Exiting, Name) {
4616 CanIVInfo = std::make_unique<VPCanonicalIVInfo>(CanIVTy, DL, this);
4617 }
4618
4619public:
4620 ~VPRegionBlock() override = default;
4621
4622 /// Method to support type inquiry through isa, cast, and dyn_cast.
4623 static inline bool classof(const VPBlockBase *V) {
4624 return V->getVPBlockID() == VPBlockBase::VPRegionBlockSC;
4625 }
4626
4627 const VPBlockBase *getEntry() const { return Entry; }
4628 VPBlockBase *getEntry() { return Entry; }
4629
4630 /// Set \p EntryBlock as the entry VPBlockBase of this VPRegionBlock. \p
4631 /// EntryBlock must have no predecessors.
4632 void setEntry(VPBlockBase *EntryBlock) {
4633 assert(!EntryBlock->hasPredecessors() &&
4634 "Entry block cannot have predecessors.");
4635 Entry = EntryBlock;
4636 EntryBlock->setParent(this);
4637 }
4638
4639 const VPBlockBase *getExiting() const { return Exiting; }
4640 VPBlockBase *getExiting() { return Exiting; }
4641
4642 /// Set \p ExitingBlock as the exiting VPBlockBase of this VPRegionBlock. \p
4643 /// ExitingBlock must have no successors.
4644 void setExiting(VPBlockBase *ExitingBlock) {
4645 assert(!ExitingBlock->hasSuccessors() &&
4646 "Exit block cannot have successors.");
4647 Exiting = ExitingBlock;
4648 ExitingBlock->setParent(this);
4649 }
4650
4651 /// Returns the pre-header VPBasicBlock of the loop region.
4652 VPBasicBlock *getPreheaderVPBB() {
4653 assert(!isReplicator() && "should only get pre-header of loop regions");
4654 return getSinglePredecessor()->getExitingBasicBlock();
4655 }
4656
4657 /// An indicator whether this region is to generate multiple replicated
4658 /// instances of output IR corresponding to its VPBlockBases.
4659 bool isReplicator() const { return !CanIVInfo; }
4660
4661 /// The method which generates the output IR instructions that correspond to
4662 /// this VPRegionBlock, thereby "executing" the VPlan.
4663 void execute(VPTransformState *State) override;
4664
4665 // Return the cost of this region.
4666 InstructionCost cost(ElementCount VF, VPCostContext &Ctx) override;
4667
4668#if !defined(NDEBUG) || defined(LLVM_ENABLE_DUMP)
4669 /// Print this VPRegionBlock to \p O (recursively), prefixing all lines with
4670 /// \p Indent. \p SlotTracker is used to print unnamed VPValue's using
4671 /// consequtive numbers.
4672 ///
4673 /// Note that the numbering is applied to the whole VPlan, so printing
4674 /// individual regions is consistent with the whole VPlan printing.
4675 void print(raw_ostream &O, const Twine &Indent,
4676 VPSlotTracker &SlotTracker) const override;
4677 using VPBlockBase::print; // Get the print(raw_stream &O) version.
4678#endif
4679
4680 /// Clone all blocks in the single-entry single-exit region of the block and
4681 /// their recipes without updating the operands of the cloned recipes.
4682 VPRegionBlock *clone() override;
4683
4684 /// Remove the current region from its VPlan, connecting its predecessor to
4685 /// its entry, and its exiting block to its successor.
4686 void dissolveToCFGLoop();
4687
4688 /// Get the canonical IV increment instruction if it exists. Otherwise, create
4689 /// a new increment before the terminator and return it. The canonical IV
4690 /// increment is subject to DCE if unused, unlike the canonical IV itself.
4691 VPInstruction *getOrCreateCanonicalIVIncrement();
4692
4693 /// Return the canonical induction variable of the region, null for
4694 /// replicating regions.
4695 VPRegionValue *getCanonicalIV() {
4696 return CanIVInfo ? CanIVInfo->getRegionValue() : nullptr;
4697 }
4698 const VPRegionValue *getCanonicalIV() const {
4699 return CanIVInfo ? CanIVInfo->getRegionValue() : nullptr;
4700 }
4701
4702 /// Return the type of the canonical IV for loop regions.
4703 Type *getCanonicalIVType() const {
4704 return CanIVInfo->getRegionValue()->getType();
4705 }
4706
4707 /// Return the header mask of the region, or null if not set.
4708 VPRegionValue *getHeaderMask() const {
4709 return CanIVInfo ? CanIVInfo->getHeaderMask() : nullptr;
4710 }
4711
4712 /// Return the header mask if it exists and is used, or null otherwise. The
4713 /// mask is materialized into concrete recipes only after costing, so cost and
4714 /// codegen accounting sites use this to skip an unused mask.
4715 VPRegionValue *getUsedHeaderMask() const {
4716 VPRegionValue *HeaderMask = getHeaderMask();
4717 return HeaderMask && HeaderMask->getNumUsers() > 0 ? HeaderMask : nullptr;
4718 }
4719
4720 /// Create the header mask for the region and return it. Must only be called
4721 /// on loop regions that don't already have a header mask.
4722 VPRegionValue *createHeaderMask() {
4723 assert(CanIVInfo && "Can only create header mask for loop regions");
4724 return CanIVInfo->createHeaderMask();
4725 }
4726
4727 /// Return the region values of the loop region (canonical IV, header mask)
4728 /// or an empty vector for replicate regions.
4729 SmallVector<VPRegionValue *, 2> getRegionValues() const {
4730 if (!CanIVInfo)
4731 return {};
4732 SmallVector<VPRegionValue *, 2> R = {CanIVInfo->getRegionValue()};
4733 if (auto *HM = CanIVInfo->getHeaderMask())
4734 R.push_back(HM);
4735 return R;
4736 }
4737
4738 /// Indicates if NUW is set for the canonical IV increment, for loop regions.
4739 bool hasCanonicalIVNUW() const { return CanIVInfo->hasNUW(); }
4740
4741 /// Unsets NUW for the canonical IV increment \p Increment, for loop regions.
4742 void clearCanonicalIVNUW(VPInstruction *Increment) {
4743 assert(Increment && "Must provide increment to clear");
4744 Increment->dropPoisonGeneratingFlags();
4745 CanIVInfo->clearNUW();
4746 }
4747};

4749inline VPRegionBlock *VPRecipeBase::getRegion() {
4750 return getParent()->getParent();
4751}

4753inline const VPRegionBlock *VPRecipeBase::getRegion() const {

4757/// VPlan models a candidate for vectorization, encoding various decisions take
4758/// to produce efficient output IR, including which branches, basic-blocks and
4759/// output IR instructions to generate, and their cost. VPlan holds a
4760/// Hierarchical-CFG of VPBasicBlocks and VPRegionBlocks rooted at an Entry
4761/// VPBasicBlock.
4762class VPlan {
4763 friend class VPlanPrinter;
4764 friend class VPSlotTracker;
4765
4766 /// VPBasicBlock corresponding to the original preheader. Used to place
4767 /// VPExpandSCEV recipes for expressions used during skeleton creation and the
4768 /// rest of VPlan execution.
4769 /// When this VPlan is used for the epilogue vector loop, the entry will be
4770 /// replaced by a new entry block created during skeleton creation.
4771 VPBasicBlock *Entry;
4772
4773 /// VPIRBasicBlock wrapping the header of the original scalar loop.
4774 VPIRBasicBlock *ScalarHeader;
4775
4776 /// Immutable list of VPIRBasicBlocks wrapping the exit blocks of the original
4777 /// scalar loop. Note that some exit blocks may be unreachable at the moment,
4778 /// e.g. if the scalar epilogue always executes.
4779 SmallVector<VPIRBasicBlock *, 2> ExitBlocks;
4780
4781 /// Holds the VFs applicable to this VPlan.
4782 SmallSetVector<ElementCount, 2> VFs;
4783
4784 /// Holds the UFs applicable to this VPlan. If empty, the VPlan is valid for
4785 /// any UF.
4786 SmallSetVector<unsigned, 2> UFs;
4787
4788 /// Holds the name of the VPlan, for printing.
4789 std::string Name;
4790
4791 /// Represents the trip count of the original loop, for folding
4792 /// the tail.
4793 VPValue *TripCount = nullptr;
4794
4795 /// Represents the backedge taken count of the original loop, for folding
4796 /// the tail. It equals TripCount - 1.
4797 VPSymbolicValue *BackedgeTakenCount = nullptr;
4798
4799 /// Represents the vector trip count.
4800 VPSymbolicValue VectorTripCount;
4801
4802 /// Represents the vectorization factor of the loop.
4803 VPSymbolicValue VF;
4804
4805 /// Represents the unroll factor of the loop.
4806 VPSymbolicValue UF;
4807
4808 /// Represents the loop-invariant VF * UF of the vector loop region.
4809 VPSymbolicValue VFxUF;
4810
4811 /// Contains all the external definitions created for this VPlan, as a mapping
4812 /// from IR Values to VPIRValues.
4813 SmallMapVector<Value *, VPIRValue *, 16> LiveIns;
4814
4815 /// Blocks allocated and owned by the VPlan. They will be deleted once the
4816 /// VPlan is destroyed.
4817 SmallVector<VPBlockBase *> CreatedBlocks;
4818
4819 /// Construct a VPlan with \p Entry to the plan and with \p ScalarHeader
4820 /// wrapping the original header of the scalar loop. The vector loop will have
4821 /// index type \p IdxTy.
4822 VPlan(VPBasicBlock *Entry, VPIRBasicBlock *ScalarHeader, Type *IdxTy)
4823 : Entry(Entry), ScalarHeader(ScalarHeader), VectorTripCount(IdxTy),
4824 VF(IdxTy), UF(IdxTy), VFxUF(IdxTy) {
4825 Entry->setPlan(this);
4826 assert(ScalarHeader->getNumSuccessors() == 0 &&
4827 "scalar header must be a leaf node");
4828 }
4829
4830public:
4831 /// Construct a VPlan for \p L. This will create VPIRBasicBlocks wrapping the
4832 /// original preheader and scalar header of \p L, to be used as entry and
4833 /// scalar header blocks of the new VPlan. The vector loop will have index
4834 /// type \p IdxTy.
4835 VPlan(Loop *L, Type *IdxTy);
4836
4837 /// Construct a VPlan with a new VPBasicBlock as entry, a VPIRBasicBlock
4838 /// wrapping \p ScalarHeaderBB and vector loop index of type \p IdxTy.
4839 VPlan(BasicBlock *ScalarHeaderBB, Type *IdxTy)
4840 : VectorTripCount(IdxTy), VF(IdxTy), UF(IdxTy), VFxUF(IdxTy) {
4841 setEntry(createVPBasicBlock("preheader"));
4842 ScalarHeader = createVPIRBasicBlock(ScalarHeaderBB);
4843 }
4844
4845 LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST ~VPlan();
4846
4847 void setEntry(VPBasicBlock *VPBB) {
4848 Entry = VPBB;
4849 VPBB->setPlan(this);
4850 }
4851
4852 /// Generate the IR code for this VPlan.
4853 void execute(VPTransformState *State);
4854
4855 /// Return the cost of this plan.
4856 InstructionCost cost(ElementCount VF, VPCostContext &Ctx);
4857
4858 VPBasicBlock *getEntry() { return Entry; }
4859 const VPBasicBlock *getEntry() const { return Entry; }
4860
4861 /// Returns the preheader of the vector loop region, if one exists, or null
4862 /// otherwise.
4863 VPBasicBlock *getVectorPreheader() const {
4864 const VPRegionBlock *VectorRegion = getVectorLoopRegion();
4865 return VectorRegion

4884 /// Returns the 'middle' block of the plan, that is the block that selects
4885 /// whether to execute the scalar tail loop or the exit block from the loop
4886 /// latch. If there is an early exit from the vector loop, the middle block
4887 /// conceptully has the early exit block as third successor, split accross 2
4888 /// VPBBs. In that case, the second VPBB selects whether to execute the scalar
4889 /// tail loop or the exit block. If the scalar tail loop or exit block are
4890 /// known to always execute, the middle block may branch directly to that
4891 /// block. This function cannot be called once the vector loop region has been
4892 /// removed.
4893 VPBasicBlock *getMiddleBlock() {
4894 VPRegionBlock *LoopRegion = getVectorLoopRegion();
4895 assert(
4896 LoopRegion &&
4897 "cannot call the function after vector loop region has been removed");
4898 // The middle block is always the last successor of the region.
4899 return cast<VPBasicBlock>(LoopRegion->getSuccessors().back());
4900 }

5035 /// Gets the live-in VPIRValue for \p V or adds a new live-in (if none exists
5036 /// yet) for \p V.
5037 VPIRValue *getOrAddLiveIn(Value *V) {
5038 assert(V && "Trying to get or add the VPIRValue of a null Value");
5039 auto [It, Inserted] = LiveIns.try_emplace(V);
5040 if (Inserted) {
5041 if (auto *CI = dyn_cast<ConstantInt>(V))
5042 It->second = new VPConstantInt(CI);
5043 else
5044 It->second = new VPIRValue(V);
5045 }
5046
5047 assert(isa<VPIRValue>(It->second) &&
5048 "Only VPIRValues should be in mapping");
5049 return It->second;
5050 }
5051 VPIRValue *getOrAddLiveIn(VPIRValue *V) {
5052 assert(V && "Trying to get or add the VPIRValue of a null VPIRValue");
5053 return getOrAddLiveIn(V->getValue());
5054 }

5130 /// is owned by the VPlan and deleted once the VPlan is destroyed.
5131 VPRegionBlock *createLoopRegion(Type *CanIVTy, DebugLoc DL,
5132 const std::string &Name = "",

5134 VPBlockBase *Exiting = nullptr) {

5141 /// returned block is owned by the VPlan and deleted once the VPlan is

5144 const std::string &Name = "") {

5153 VPIRBasicBlock *createEmptyVPIRBasicBlock(BasicBlock *IRBB);

5155 /// Create a VPIRBasicBlock from \p IRBB containing VPIRInstructions for all
5156 /// instructions in \p IRBB, except its terminator which is managed by the
5157 /// successors of the block in VPlan. The returned block is owned by the VPlan
5158 /// and deleted once the VPlan is destroyed.
5159 LLVM_ABI_FOR_TEST VPIRBasicBlock *createVPIRBasicBlock(BasicBlock *IRBB);
5160
5161 /// Returns true if the VPlan is based on a loop with an early exit.
5162 bool hasEarlyExit() const {
5163 unsigned NumExitPredecessors =
5164 sum_of(map_range(ExitBlocks, [](VPIRBasicBlock *EB) {
5165 return EB->getNumPredecessors();
5166 }));
5167
5168 // If the scalar preheader executes unconditionally, there's no branch from
5169 // middle block to any exit. If there is any edge to an exit block
5170 // remaining, it must be an early exit.
5171 VPBasicBlock *ScalarPH = getScalarPreheader();
5172 VPBlockBase *ScalarPHPred =
5173 ScalarPH ? ScalarPH->getSinglePredecessor() : nullptr;
5174 if (ScalarPHPred && ScalarPHPred->getNumSuccessors() == 1)
5175 return NumExitPredecessors >= 1;
5176
5177 // Otherwise there must be at least 2 edges to exit blocks (from the middle
5178 // block and the early exiting edge).
5179 return NumExitPredecessors > 1;
5180 }
5181
5182 /// Returns true if the scalar tail may execute after the vector loop, i.e.
5183 /// if the middle block is a predecessor of the scalar preheader. Note that
5184 /// this relies on unneeded branches to the scalar tail loop being removed.
5185 bool hasScalarTail() const {
5186 auto *ScalarPH = getScalarPreheader();
5187 return ScalarPH &&
5188 is_contained(ScalarPH->getPredecessors(), getMiddleBlock());
5189 }
5190
5191 /// The type of the canonical induction variable of the vector loop.
5192 Type *getIndexType() const { return VF.getType(); }
